meta.name: Project Atlas
meta.title: HR policy and process documentation program
meta.tagline: Every HR policy, process and legal obligation documented, approved, live and owned in 13 jurisdictions within 12 months.

holidayFreezes.label: Year-end freeze: no approvals or launches
Lunar New Year and Tet: China, Taiwan and Vietnam reviewers away

waves.name: Mobilize
waves.goal: Team, charter, tooling, approval chains and a rated baseline of all 438 items.
waves.scope: Setup only; no items go live.

waves.name: Wave 1: Must-haves
waves.goal: The highest-risk legally required, public-company and semiconductor items in every workstream: policies first, then the programs, notices and controls that depend on them.
waves.scope: About 40% of each workstream's legally required, public-company and semiconductor items, ranked by risk.

waves.name: Wave 2: Core lifecycle
waves.goal: The next tranche of required items, with the bulk of process documentation and country addenda.
waves.scope: The next 35% of each workstream's required items.

waves.name: Wave 3: Complete coverage
waves.goal: The remaining required items, so every legal, public-company and semiconductor item is live.
waves.scope: The remaining 25% of each workstream's required items.

waves.name: Wave 4: Embed and sustain
waves.goal: Best-practice items, the global attestation campaign, audit readiness and handover to business-as-usual owners.
waves.scope: All best-practice items plus close-out activities.

workstreams.name: Governance, Ethics and Employee Relations
workstreams.partners: Employment counsel; Ethics and Compliance; Internal Audit
workstreams.scope: Code of conduct, harassment, whistleblowing, investigations, discipline, inclusion, corporate governance and insider trading items.

workstreams.name: Talent Acquisition
workstreams.scope: Workforce planning, requisitions, sourcing, selection, background checks, offers and deemed-export screening.

workstreams.name: HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle
workstreams.scope: Onboarding, I-9 and right-to-work, transfers and mobility, international assignments, separations and exits.

workstreams.name: Total Rewards and Payroll
workstreams.partners: Payroll; Stock Administration; Finance; Benefits brokers
workstreams.scope: Pay practices, payroll compliance, salary structures, bonus and sales compensation, equity administration and benefits.

workstreams.name: Talent, Leave and Engagement
workstreams.scope: Leave and accommodation, performance, development, promotion, engagement and listening.

workstreams.name: HR Data, Safety and Systems
workstreams.scope: HR data governance, privacy, records retention, HR systems controls, health and safety programs and crisis response.

crossCutting.name: Country implementation
crossCutting.scope: Country addenda, translations, employee-representative consultation, filings and local launch in all 13 jurisdictions.

crossCutting.name: Legal and compliance review
crossCutting.scope: Legal review of every policy and legally required item; local counsel engagement; regulator filings.

crossCutting.name: Change, communications and training
crossCutting.scope: Stakeholder engagement, communications calendar, manager toolkits, training and attestation.

crossCutting.name: Program management office
crossCutting.scope: Plan, RAID log, approval chains, status reporting, steering committee and document control.

stages.label: Discover
stages.done: Current state captured: existing documents found, gaps rated, owner confirmed.

stages.label: Draft
stages.done: Draft complete in the standard template, with country addenda and controls.

stages.label: Review
stages.done: SME, legal and country review comments resolved.

stages.label: Approve
stages.done: Approval chain complete, with every sign-off recorded.

stages.label: Go live
stages.done: Published, communicated, trained where needed and evidence filed.

milestones.name: Project kickoff
milestones.criteria: Kickoff held with sponsor, workstream leads, regional HR leads and Legal.

milestones.name: Charter approved
milestones.criteria: Steering committee approves charter, scope, resourcing and governance.

milestones.name: Approval chains configured
milestones.criteria: Every chain has named approvers; test submission run end to end.

milestones.name: Baseline complete and Mobilize gate
milestones.criteria: All 438 items have an owner, a current-state rating and a wave; plan v1.0 baselined.

milestones.name: Wave 1 starts
milestones.criteria: Wave 1 items in Discover; workshops scheduled.

milestones.name: Wave 1 drafts complete
milestones.criteria: All Wave 1 drafts submitted for review before the year-end freeze.

milestones.name: Wave 1 approvals complete
milestones.criteria: Every Wave 1 approval chain closed; works council consultations started where required.

milestones.name: Wave 1 live
milestones.criteria: Wave 1 published, communicated and evidenced; wave retrospective held.

milestones.name: Wave 2 drafts complete
milestones.criteria: All Wave 2 drafts submitted for review.

milestones.name: Wave 3 drafts complete
milestones.criteria: All Wave 3 drafts submitted for review.

milestones.name: Wave 3 live: all required items done
milestones.criteria: Every legal, public-company and semiconductor item is live with evidence.

milestones.name: Global attestation campaign launched
milestones.criteria: All employees asked to acknowledge the updated Code and core policies.

milestones.name: Audit readiness review
milestones.criteria: Internal Audit samples 40 items and confirms evidence is complete.

milestones.name: Handover to business as usual
milestones.criteria: Every item has a named owner, a review date and a place in the annual review calendar.

milestones.name: Project close
milestones.criteria: Close-out report and lessons learned approved by the steering committee.

chains.name: Global policy
chains.description: For every global policy and its country addenda.

steps.name: Owner sign-off
steps.guidance: Confirms the draft is complete, uses the standard template and has every country addendum.

steps.name: Workstream review
steps.guidance: Checks consistency with related policies and processes.

steps.name: Legal review
steps.guidance: Confirms legal requirements are met in every jurisdiction; engages local counsel where needed.

steps.name: Regional HR review
steps.guidance: Each region confirms the addenda are workable and flags consultation or filing needs.

steps.name: Employee representative consultation
steps.guidance: Required where works councils or employee representatives have rights (Germany, China, Vietnam, Taiwan filings). Record the outcome; skip with a note where not needed.

steps.name: Final approval
steps.guidance: Approves publication and the effective date.

chains.name: Process document
chains.description: For process maps, steps, controls and RACI.

steps.name: Process owner sign-off
steps.guidance: Confirms the flow matches how work is actually done, including exceptions.

steps.name: Workstream review
steps.guidance: Checks hand-offs with other processes and the governing policy.

steps.name: Control review
steps.guidance: Required when the process contains a key or SOX-relevant control.

steps.name: Publish approval
steps.guidance: Approves publication and confirms systems and training are ready.

chains.name: Legal obligation
chains.appliesTo: Filings, notices, programs, trainings, records and committees
chains.description: For legally required items in the obligations register.

steps.name: Owner sign-off
steps.guidance: Confirms the obligation is met and evidence is filed.

steps.name: Legal and compliance review
steps.guidance: Confirms the evidence satisfies the requirement and the next due date is set.

steps.name: Country HR confirmation
steps.guidance: Confirms local completion, language and posting or filing.

chains.name: Public company and semiconductor control
chains.description: For SOX, SEC, Nasdaq, insider trading and export-control items.

steps.name: Compliance review
steps.guidance: Confirms the control is designed effectively and testable.

steps.name: Executive approval
steps.guidance: Approves for audit and disclosure purposes.

steps.name: PMO review
steps.guidance: Confirms the document is complete and consistent with the plan.

steps.name: Steering committee
steps.guidance: Any steering committee member may record the committee's decision.
